intro: Destruction in Deadmines is a covert sabotage mission coordinated by Alba Fairmoon to strike at the heart of the Defias Brotherhood's industrial operations. Deep within the labyrinthine tunnels beneath Moonbrook, the Brotherhood runs a massive metallurgical forge suspected of poisoning the surrounding land. Adventurers are tasked with penetrating the complex, planting powerful explosives near the foundry, and crippling the brotherhood's war effort.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The source of the poison is likely a large metallurgical forge of some kind. Find a way into the Deadmines and locate the forge, then place the explosives.
I will wait for you in the hills behind Moonbrook. Once you return, we can detonate the explosives. Hopefully with the forge gone, the land can begin to heal.
